12 epochs: finality paused 58 min with 4 of 9 validating
4.5k of 59.2k slots missed over the nine days, 99 % of them in hours when at least one node was not validating (correlation with the number of nodes down:
0.98); 59 missed with all nine validating. No reorg was seen by more than two of the nine sentries (616 single-node head switches). Finality paused once, on
fork day, when five nodes were down at once (three geths recovering, two erigons stalled) and resumed as two came back.
